feature_contract.goal: Restore original four-vertex custom-matrix main-menu and car-selection sprite proportions on 4:3, 16:9, 21:9 and portrait screens by applying one contain transform to both X and Y axes, without disturbing game world, Vanilla, desktop F11 or device-loss fallback.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only main and car-selection custom-matrix multi-quad scale and center ownership in src/hooks_uiscaling.cpp; exclude external ImGui F11, ESC gameplay pause, speed/time/rank gameplay HUD, SkyGlow, world stereo, FFB, DX11, DXVK, Localization.
trace_stages: Original OutRun 2006 game custom-matrix multi-sprite producers create four-vertex menu and selection quads with stride 9, 11 and 13 projected into stretched source screen pixel coordinates.

UIScaling custom-matrix mid hooks preserve original matrices and detect OnlineArcade/KeepCentered modes, then CenterMultiSpriteQuad transforms source pixel X and Y into centered native contain geometry.
The D3D9Ex original game Draw path and active VR stereo renderer transfer menu geometry to binocular headset compositor; unchanged world and external F11 draws retain separate ownership.
subcomponents: Implement shared finite X/Y contain geometry across all three original four-vertex multi-menu layout strides, including portrait top and bottom margins.
Reject malformed/nonfinite scale and vertex data atomically and preserve Vanilla/desktop F11 plus source-size/reset geometry fallbacks.
Exercise 4:3, 16:9, 21:9 and portrait compile-time coordinate assertions and full Win32 game/host/package and Domain Isolation exact-SHA gates.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: All three original custom-matrix quad variants transform X and Y by the same aspect-preserving contain factor and correctly center 4:3/16:9/21:9/portrait native menu geometry.
Vanilla and unrelated game world/F11 drawing remain untouched while invalid source scale, nonfinite vertices or Reset transients never partially mutate an original menu quad.

One identical validation-bearing SHA passes the complete canonical DX9Ex Active policy, Win32 host/game/full-chain/package, Domain Isolation and source impact checks as required; Quest3 optical validation stays separate.

diagnosis.original_evidence: User Quest3/VDXR capture reports main and selection menu stretched; four original OutRun custom-matrix quad sources used a widened Y scale after legacy center hooks only remapped X.
source_trace: Original game draws multi-sprite quads through stride 9/11/13 callsites selected by draw_sprite_custom_matrix_multi callbacks.
UI scaling hooks intercept native game producer vertices and historically centered only X despite independent width/height screen scales.
Renderer consumes the corrected game draw vertices on active left/right binocular passes while device Reset/Vanilla and ImGui F11 retain independent paths.
diagnosis.root_cause: The old center handlers transformed only horizontal coordinates and left vertical coordinates at anisotropic source screen scaling. On portrait or nonnative aspect they produced malformed menu proportions.
alternatives_rejected: Changing global VR HUD scale would also distort gameplay HUD and ESC controls and cannot correct original quad anisotropy.
Changing world projection or native OpenXR eye size is unrelated to original 2D menu vertex geometry.
Using width-only centering again cannot repair portrait letterboxing and would retain the known vertical stretch.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Only original custom-matrix main-menu/selection UI quads use shared contain geometry before per-eye stereo composition; world, original D3D9 scene, external ImGui F11 and pause/game HUD owners do not use this transform.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Source material 355ca708ae22ef67fafb64d7896d2f0f92d316dd adds finite, all-or-nothing four-vertex X/Y contain normalization for three strides. MSVC compilation repair 60984e40d64d08aaf5e356d192b585b3f151fa5f places constexpr and assertions at namespace scope.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Compile-time assertions cover 4:3, widescreen and portrait geometry; source handles nonfinite/reset scales and vertices without partial quad writes. Full gate must confirm compilation.
diagnosis.repair_evidence: Earlier DX9Ex Active #38495302584 and #38495354295 failed during policy before Win32 jobs because docs/automation/runs/CONVERSION-DX9EX-00814.json was absent; this commit restores the canonical record. No CI/HMD PASS has been claimed.
